content: We train the model using a negative log-likelihood loss, and used Adam BIBREF24 optimization. For weights initialization we rely on BIBREF25. We used a grid search to validate the hyper-parameters. The model converged at around 30 epochs and produced good results with 0.9 drop-out and a beam of size 4. During inference, we seek the best candidate path using beam-search and normalize the scores of the sequences according to BIBREF26.
